name: Greek Pastitsio Beef Pasta Bake

components.name: Beef Pastitsio

ingredients.name: Raw dry thick macaroni or penne

steps: Cook diced red onions and garlic in oil, then brown minced beef thoroughly. Add tomato paste, canned tomatoes, beef stock and spices; simmer until filling is dense and spoonable.
Boil pasta in measured water until slightly firmer than al dente; drain the water completely. Fold feta and egg whites into the cooled pasta.
In another saucepan prepare the cheese topping: melt butter, stir in flour, whisk in milk and cook until thick; turn off heat and mix in parmesan and nutmeg.
When the sauce cools slightly, temper egg yolks into it so they do not scramble.
Heat oven to 180 C. Place pasta at base of a deep dish, add the beef mixture, level it, then cover with the béchamel.
Bake roughly 30-40 minutes until well browned. Rest 15-20 minutes for clean slices, then cut eight portions.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Uses stock instead of wine and fixed raw weights. Creator source is classic Pastitsio with layered pasta and cheese topping.
Planning: SECONDARY STOVETOP: requires pasta, beef sauce and béchamel first.
Freezer: freezes well as complete slices
Dietary: Contains dairy, wheat and eggs.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
